financings_after_balance_sheet.what: June 2024 public offering via H.C. Wainwright (shares/pre-funded warrants with Series C-1/C-2 warrants); closing date not stated, so the offering's filing date is used
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: excluding the net proceeds, if any, from the exercise of the Warrants, is approximately $3.2 million

warrants.quote: Each Series B-1 Common Warrant is exercisable into one share of Common Stock at a price per share of $1.10 for a five-year period after February 6, 2024, the date of issuance.
Each Series B-2 Common Warrant is exercisable into one share of Common Stock at a price per share of $1.10 for an 18-month period after February 6,2024, the date of issuance.
Each Pre-Funded Warrant is exercisable for one share of Common Stock at a price per share of $0.0001 and does not expire.
